subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, legal/security checklist, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Garcia <sara.garcia@brightwell.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@brightwell.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, legal/security checklist, and QBR scheduling

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed, Brightwell's commit renewal window is approaching and we'd like to formally kick off coordination so we can align on:

- committed capacity uplift (expected +40% token volume during pilots)
- proposed term amendment and pricing tiers
- security & compliance evidence for procurement (SOC 2, encryption-at-rest details)
- QBR timing and agenda for executive and engineering stakeholders

Attached are two starting artifacts: (1) a draft Mutual Action & Adoption Plan (Brightwell_MAAP_Draft_v1.pdf) with milestone suggestions and (2) a QBR agenda template (QBR-Agenda-Template.docx). Please review and flag any missing stakeholders.

Proposed timeline (high-level):
1) This week — confirm stakeholders (legal, procurement, security, eng execs) and required evidence items
2) Next 7–10 days — Redwood provides SOC2 summary, KMS integration notes, and a proposed amendment for review
3) Week of May 29 — joint technical run-through and capacity ramp plan; finalize commercial terms
4) Early June — sign amendment + QBR (can be remote)

Can you confirm (by EOD Tue) who from procurement/security will own evidence requests, and which 2–3 dates in the week of June 5 work for the QBR?

Next steps for us internally: I'll loop in Karthik on capacity planning and Laura on legal/contracting. Rafael will prepare a cost sensitivity for the suggested uplift so you have a few pricing options.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Brightwell_MAAP_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 280KB); QBR-Agenda-Template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAAP — very helpful. Quick answers:

- Procurement lead: Tom Nguyen (cc'd) will own the commercial review and PO path.
- Security/compliance: I will own the SOC2 evidence requests initially; our security lead (internal) will join the technical call.
- Proposed QBR slots for week of June 5: Tue 6/6 11:00am PT, Wed 6/7 9:30am PT, or Thu 6/8 3:00pm PT. We can narrow once you propose the invite.

On the SOC2 items — can you send the SOC2 summary and a short note on your KMS/HSM integrations and data retention policies? Procurement will also want to know any material changes to the billing model for committed capacity vs overage.

We reviewed the MAAP at a high level; procurement/legal will expect a redline to the current SOW that reflects the uplift and term changes. Can your legal team prepare an initial amendment for review? We'll push that through our contracting queue when we have it.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Garcia
Director of Platform Engineering | Brightwell Health

Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, legal/security checklist, and QBR scheduling

Adding a few technical notes from capacity/serving side:

- Capacity ramp options: we can support a staged rollout (10% -> 40% -> 100%) across a 3-week window to limit cold-starts and token cost spikes. That keeps tail latency stable while you ramp traffic.
- Canary path: recommend a canary route pinned to the same model family but with fixed quantization profile; this avoids any perf regressions while saving cost.
- KV/prefix caching: If you expect a lot of repeated prompts for the pilot, we can enable prefix caching to cut amortized token costs by ~12–18%. Rafael, can you add the estimated cost for both staged and immediate ramp in the amendment options?

Sara — for SOC2/KMS items: our security brief will include a one-page KMS diagram and a short FAQ on encryption-in-transit and at-rest. I'll attach the security brief draft after I run it by infra (ETA Monday).

Looping in Laura for legal on amendment templates.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses and the suggested QBR slots. We can take Tue 6/6 11:00am PT for the QBR — I'll send a calendar invite with a 60-minute agenda and invite list.

Immediate next steps (owners & ETA):
- Redwood to deliver: SOC2 one-pager + KMS diagram (Soojin/Karthik) — ETA Mon 5/20
- Redwood to provide: amendment redline (Laura) — initial draft ETA Thu 5/23
- Redwood to provide: cost sensitivity table for staged vs immediate ramp (Rafael) — ETA Wed 5/22
- Brightwell to provide: security lead contact and procurement PO path confirmation (Sara/Tom) — ETA Tue 5/23

I'll start the amendment draft based on the MAAP and Rafael's inputs; it will include three commercial options: baseline renew (no uplift), staged ramp with step-up pricing, and immediate uplift with committed discount. When the redline is ready I'll post it to the HubSpot deal record and share a DocuSign link for faster routing.

Calendar invite + HubSpot link coming shortly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
